title: Competitor Research Questions

lessons.title: Course Material: Competitor-Research-Questions.pdf
lessons.content:
PAGE_1:
IAPWE Professional Development Series 1 Profitable Pricing – Competitor Research Questions  Instructions: Answer the following questions for each of your main competitors. Use the Know Your Competitors spreadsheet to summarize and keep track of multiple competitors.  How does your competitor market to its customers?       What are your competitor's prices like?

PAGE_2:
IAPWE Professional Development Series 2 What unique value does your competitor offer?      How does your competitor innovate and how does this innovation translate into better value?       How big is your competitor and how many employees do they employ?

PAGE_3:
IAPWE Professional Development Series 3 What is the caliber of the competitor's employees in terms of quality of service, experience, skill level, big names, and so on?      Who owns the business?      Where in the media can you find your competitor (advertising on television, active on social media, etc.)?

PAGE_4:
IAPWE Professional Development Series 4 What kind of web presence does the competitor have and how much engagement is there with its customers?      What is the competitor's reputation like (look at online reviews, search for comments on social media, conduct your own market research, and so on)?     How does your competitor distribute or deliver its products or services?

PAGE_5:
IAPWE Professional Development Series 5 What special services does the competitor offer customers?      If the competitor is a public company, obtain a copy of its annual report.       What kind of sales does it see?

PAGE_6:
IAPWE Professional Development Series 6 What do the competitor's customers see as its strengths and weaknesses?      What is the company's customer loyalty like (look for long-standing customers)?      Has there been an influx or decrease of customers recently?

PAGE_7:
IAPWE Professional Development Series 7 What new products is the company developing?         What financial resources does the company have?
